The change specification has been handed over and accepted across all sections:

- `header.json`: 7 conventions, 4 architectural decisions, 2 file checks (`prettier`, `test`), and 1 project check (`test-typecheck-lint`).
- `units-001.json`: 6 codegen units (`U01`–`U06`) covering `schema.ts`, `useTemplateSchema.ts`, `ReviewState/util.ts`, `ReviewState/ReviewState.tsx`, `Stepper/createAsyncValidators.ts`, and `Stepper/Stepper.tsx`.
- `units-002.json`: 6 test units (`U07`–`U12`) and 2 documentation/changeset units (`U13`–`U14`).
